Using multivariable logistic regression, we identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical associations with SLD (CAP ≥ 248 dB/m), and evaluated whether SLD severity was independently associated with fibrosis. Short-term impacts of SLD on mortality were also assessed with Cox proportional hazards analysis. We also evaluated the diagnostic performance of B-mode ultrasound for SLD, with CAP as reference. Across 6 countries and 1601 participants (age range, 12-80 years; 39.5% female; 4% with diabetes; 11% unhealthy alcohol use; median body mass index, 24.4), 421 (26.3%) had SLD; 219 (13.7%) had severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). Older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status were associated with SLD. After adjusting for age, sex, HIV status, HBV treatment, and country, severe steatosis, but not mild and moderate forms (i.e., 248-279 dB/m), was associated with a 8.4% (95%, 1.9%-14.9%) increased probability of fibrosis. Over limited follow-up (median 2.69 years) and small number of deaths, SLD was not associated with all-cause or liver-related mortality. B-mode ultrasound had low sensitivity for SLD, overall or when severe, but specificity was 95%. In conclusion, SLD was common in people with CHB in Africa and its severe form was associated with liver fibrosis. These data support screening for metabolic comorbidities as part of HBV care and treatment in Africa.
authors: Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET)

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address data gaps on metabolic liver disease in Africa by evaluating participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection for steatotic liver disease using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). The research was conducted across six countries involving 1601 participants, with 421 (26.3%) found to have SLD and 219 (13.7%) with severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). The study identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical factors associated with SLD, including older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status. After adjusting for various factors, severe steatosis was linked to an increased probability of fibrosis. However, SLD was not associated with mortality during limited follow-up. The findings highlight the importance of screening for metabolic comorbidities in HBV care and suggest that severe steatosis may be a marker for fibrosis. The study's limitations include its short follow-up period and small number of deaths, which may affect the strength of conclusions about mortality.

papers.abstract_zh: 为了解决非洲地区代谢性肝病的数据缺口,我们在非洲乙型肝炎合作网络(HEPSANET)中评估了慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者是否患有脂肪性肝病(SLD),使用了瞬时弹性成像结合控制衰减参数(CAP)。通过多变量逻辑回归分析,我们确定了与SLD(CAP ≥ 248 dB/m)相关的社会人口学、人体测量学和临床特征,并评估了SLD严重程度是否独立与纤维化相关。我们还使用Cox比例风险模型评估了SLD对死亡率的短期影响。此外,我们评估了B型超声波在SLD诊断中的表现,以CAP为参考标准。在6个国家的1601名参与者(年龄范围12-80岁;39.5%女性;4%患有糖尿病;11%有不健康饮酒行为;中位数体重指数24.4)中,421名(26.3%)患有SLD;219名(13.7%)患有严重脂肪变(CAP ≥ 280 dB/m)。年龄较大、男性性别、超重和肥胖以及HIV阴性状态与SLD相关。在调整年龄、性别、HIV状态、HBV 治疗和国家后,严重脂肪变(而非轻度和中度形式,即248-279 dB/m)与纤维化概率增加8.4%(95%置信区间1.9%-14.9%)相关。在有限的随访时间(中位数2.69年)和较少的死亡病例下,SLD与全因或肝相关死亡率无显著关联。B型超声波对SLD的敏感性较低,无论是整体还是在严重情况下,但特异性为95%。总之,SLD在非洲CHB患者中较为常见,其严重形式与肝纤维化相关。这些数据支持在非洲HBV管理中纳入代谢性共病的筛查措施以及治疗的监测。

papers.title: Becoming Physically Active and Risks of Mortality and Liver-Related Events in Adults With Chronic Hepatitis B: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Physical activity (PA) confers several health benefits; however, whether increasing PA among physically inactive adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is associated with lower risks of adverse clinical outcomes remains unclear. We used the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database. We included 318,131 adults with CHB who were physically inactive at the initial health screening (Exam 1) and completed a subsequent screening within 4 years (Exam 2). Among them, 58,703 initiated moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA), defined as vigorous activity ≥ 20 min/day on ≥ 3 days/week or moderate activity ≥ 30 min/day on ≥ 5 days/week. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality, and the secondary outcomes were liver-related events (hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC]) and HCC. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Grey competing-risk models were adjusted for demographic, clinical, and behavioural factors. During a median 7.9-year follow-up (IQR, 5.2-9.5), 7609 deaths occurred. MVPA initiation was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), a lower risk of liver-related events (subdistribution HR [subHR], 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and, more modestly, of HCC (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared with those remaining inactive. The association was more pronounced in older adults, women, never smokers, non-drinkers, and untreated participants (all p for interaction ≤ 0.03). Initiating MVPA among physically inactive adults with CHB was associated with lower risks of mortality and liver-related outcomes. These findings provide large-scale epidemiological evidence supporting further evaluation of PA promotion in physically inactive patients with CHB.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between initiating moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) and reduced risks of mortality and liver-related events in adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Using the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database, the researchers followed 318,131 physically inactive adults with CHB over a median of 7.9 years. They found that MVPA initiation was linked to lower all-cause mortality (HR, 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), reduced liver-related events (subHR, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and a modest decrease in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared to those who remained inactive. The associations were stronger in specific subgroups, including older adults, women, and untreated participants. The study highlights the potential public health significance of promoting physical activity in CHB patients, though it does not provide direct causal evidence.

papers.title: Abstract C081: Immigration history and acculturation-related factors in relation to health-related quality of life and depressive symptoms among Korean American patients with Chronic Hepatitis B (CHB)
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) disproportionately affects Asian Americans, especially Korean Americans, and increases risk for long-term complications, including liver cancer. Immigration history, such as age/life stage at U.S. arrival, and acculturation-related factors, such as English proficiency and cultural identity, may shape physical and mental health-related quality of life among individuals living with CHB, but these relationships remain understudied. We examined whether these factors are associated with physical and mental health-related quality of life, and depressive symptoms among Korean American patients with CHB. Methods: We used baseline survey data collected in 2022-2023 from 365 Korean American CHB patients receiving care at two clinical settings in Philadelphia and Los Angeles. Outcomes were the SF-12v2 Physical Component Summary (PCS) and Mental Component Summary (MCS) scores, and the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) depressive-symptom score. Results: Participants had a mean age of 60.1 years and were 55.6% male and predominantly foreign-born (82.9%), with most arriving in the U.S. Overall mean PCS, MCS, and PHQ-9 scores were 48.56±7.25, 47.65±7.00, and 3.66±4.16, respectively. Age/life stage at arrival was significantly associated with PCS (p≤0.001), but not MCS or PHQ-9. PCS was highest among U.S.-born participants (53.81±4.72) and those who arrived during childhood or adolescence (51.99±5.28), and lower among adult arrivals ages 18–34 (48.07±7.29) and ages 35 years or older (47.16±7.56). English proficiency was associated with PCS (p≤0.001), MCS (p≤0.05), and PHQ-9 (p≤0.05); participants with poor or no English proficiency had the lowest PCS (45.68±8.07) and highest PHQ-9 scores (4.48±4.89). Cultural identity was associated with PCS (p<0.001), with the highest PCS among mostly or very Westernized participants (53.35±3.91) and the lowest PCS among very/mostly Korean participants (47.66±7.48). Multivariable analyses will examine whether these relationships remain after adjustment for sociodemographic factors. Conclusions: Immigration history and acculturation-related factors were most consistently associated with physical health-related quality of life. English proficiency was also related to mental health-related quality of life and depressive symptoms. These preliminary findings highlight the value of culturally and linguistically responsive support in CHB care and liver cancer prevention for Asian American communities. Citation Format: Eunji Kim, Ann Klassen, Giyoung Lee, Amy Auchincloss, Sandra Bloom, Stephanie Ewing, Mimi Chang, Kyunghee Koh, Hee-Soon Juon. In: Proceedings of the 19th AACR Conference on the Science of Cancer Health Disparities; 2026 Oct 18-21; Atlanta, GA. Philadelphia (PA): AACR; Cancer Epidemiol Biomarkers Prev 2026;35(10 Suppl):Abstract nr C081.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) disproportionately affects Asian Americans, especially Korean Americans, and increases risk for long-term complications, including liver cancer. Immigration history, such as age/life stage at U.S. arrival, and acculturation-related factors, such as English proficiency and cultural identity, may shape physical and mental health-related quality of life among individuals living with CHB, but these relationships remain understudied. We examined whether these factors are associated with physical and mental health-related quality of life, and depressive symptoms among Korean American patients with CHB. Methods: We used baseline survey data collected in 2022-2023 from 365 Korean American CHB patients receiving care at two clinical settings in Philadelphia and Los Angeles. Outcomes were the SF-12v2 Physical Component Summary (PCS) and Mental Component Summary (MCS) scores, and the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) depressive-symptom score. Results: Participants had a mean age of 60.1 years and were 55.6% male and predominantly foreign-born (82.9%), with most arriving in the U.S. Overall mean PCS, MCS, and PHQ-9 scores were 48.56±7.25, 47.65±7.00, and 3.66±4.16, respectively. Age/life stage at arrival was significantly associated with PCS (p≤0.001), but not MCS or PHQ-9. PCS was highest among U.S.-born participants (53.81±4.72) and those who arrived during childhood or adolescence (51.99±5.28), and lower among adult arrivals ages 18–34 (48.07±7.29) and ages 35 years or older (47.16±7.56). English proficiency was associated with PCS (p≤0.001), MCS (p≤0.05), and PHQ-9 (p≤0.05); participants with poor or no English proficiency had the lowest PCS (45.68±8.07) and highest PHQ-9 scores (4.48±4.89). Cultural identity was associated with PCS (p<0.001), with the highest PCS among mostly or very Westernized participants (53.35±3.91) and the lowest PCS among very/mostly Korean participants (47.66±7.48). Multivariable analyses will examine whether these relationships remain after adjustment for sociodemographic factors. Conclusions: Immigration history and acculturation-related factors were most consistently associated with physical health-related quality of life. English proficiency was also related to mental health-related quality of life and depressive symptoms. These preliminary findings highlight the value of culturally and linguistically responsive support in CHB care and liver cancer prevention for Asian American communities. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景:慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)主要影响亚洲裔美国人,尤其是韩国裔美国人,并增加长期并发症(包括肝癌)的风险。移民史(如抵达美国时的年龄/人生阶段)以及与适应相关因素(如英语熟练程度和文化认同)可能影响患有CHB的人群的身心健康相关生活质量,但这些关系尚未得到充分研究。我们探讨了这些因素是否与韩国裔美国人慢性乙型肝炎患者的身心健康相关生活质量及抑郁症状相关。方法:我们使用了2022-2023年从费城和洛杉矶两家临床机构收集的365名韩国裔美国人慢性乙型肝炎患者的基线调查数据。结果:参与者平均年龄为60.1岁,其中55.6%为男性,且大多数为出生在国外(82.9%),大部分在抵达美国时处于不同年龄段。总体平均的SF-12v2身体成分总结(PCS)得分、心理成分总结(MCS)得分和PHQ-9抑郁症状得分分别为48.56±7.25、47.65±7.00和3.66±4.16。抵达美国时的年龄/人生阶段与PCS显著相关(p≤0.001),但与MCS或PHQ-9无显著相关性。PCS得分最高的是美国出生的参与者(53.81±4.72)以及在童年或青少年时期抵达的参与者(51.99±5.28),而18-34岁成人抵达的参与者(48.07±7.29)和35岁及以上成人抵达的参与者(47.16±7.56)得分较低。英语熟练程度与PCS(p≤0.001)、MCS(p≤0.05)和PHQ-9(p≤0.05)均相关;英语熟练程度差或没有的参与者PCS得分最低(45.68±8.07),PHQ-9得分最高(4.48±4.89)。文化认同与PCS相关(p<0.001),其中主要或非常西方化的参与者PCS得分最高(53.35±3.91),而非常或主要韩国化的参与者PCS得分最低(47.66±7.48)。多变量分析将探讨这些关系在调整社会人口学因素后是否仍然存在。结论:移民史和与适应相关因素最一致地与身体相关的健康生活质量相关。英语熟练程度也与心理健康相关生活质量及抑郁症状相关。这些初步发现强调了为亚洲裔美国人社区提供文化及语言适应性支持在慢性乙型肝炎治疗和肝癌预防中的重要性。引用格式:Eunji Kim,Ann Klassen,Giyoung Lee,Amy Auchincloss,Sandra Bloom,Stephanie Ewing,Mimi Chang,Kyunghee Koh,Hee-Soon Juon. 韩国裔美国人慢性乙型肝炎患者移民史及与适应相关因素与健康相关生活质量及抑郁症状的关系 [摘要]. 出处:第19届AACR癌症健康差异科学会议论文集;2026年10月18-21日;佐治亚州亚特兰大市。费城(PA):AACR;Cancer Epidemiol Biomarkers Prev 2026;35(10 Suppl):摘要编号C081。

papers.title: Whole-Brain Magnetic Susceptibility Alterations in Minimal Hepatic Encephalopathy Associated With Hepatitis B Virus-Related Decompensated Cirrhosis
papers.abstract: Abstract Minimal hepatic encephalopathy (MHE) is a clinically covert complication of cirrhosis, but its whole-brain magnetic susceptibility pattern remains incompletely characterized. We investigated regional relative susceptibility in 31 healthy controls (HCs), 26 patients with hepatitis B virus-related decompensated cirrhosis without MHE (NMHE), and 13 patients with MHE. Multi-echo 3.0-T gradient-echo data were reconstructed using quantitative susceptibility mapping, and 249 regional labels were analyzed with nonparametric pairwise tests and Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) correction. Twenty-one labels differed between HCs and MHE and 21 between HCs and NMHE, whereas no label differed between MHE and NMHE after FDR correction. Seven cortical regions were shared by both patient-versus-control comparisons and showed a numerical HC

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the whole-brain magnetic susceptibility pattern in minimal hepatic encephalopathy (MHE), a covert complication of cirrhosis, particularly in the context of hepatitis B virus-related disease.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study compared 31 healthy controls (HCs), 26 patients with hepatitis B virus-related decompensated cirrhosis without MHE (NMHE), and 13 patients with MHE to identify regional susceptibility differences.
analysis.methods: Quantitative susceptibility mapping was used to analyze multi-echo 3.0-T gradient-echo data, with nonparametric pairwise tests and Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) correction applied to 249 regional labels.
analysis.main_results: Twenty-one regional labels showed differences between HCs and MHE, and 21 between HCs and NMHE, but no labels differed between MHE and NMHE after FDR correction.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest distinct susceptibility patterns in MHE compared to healthy controls and non-MHE cirrhosis patients, highlighting potential neuroimaging biomarkers for MHE detection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of non-invasive neuroimaging techniques for early detection of MHE in patients with hepatitis B virus-related cirrhosis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only analysis, and the evidence is based on statistical comparisons without detailed clinical or biological mechanisms, resulting in moderate confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whole-brain magnetic susceptibility patterns in patients with hepatitis B virus-related cirrhosis, focusing on minimal hepatic encephalopathy (MHE). Using quantitative susceptibility mapping, the researchers compared 31 healthy controls, 26 patients without MHE, and 13 patients with MHE. They identified 21 regional labels differing between healthy controls and MHE patients, and 21 between healthy controls and non-MHE cirrhosis patients. However, no differences were observed between MHE and non-MHE groups after false discovery rate correction. The findings suggest distinct susceptibility patterns in MHE, potentially offering neuroimaging biomarkers for early detection. The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the results are interpreted with moderate confidence due to the absence of detailed clinical or biological mechanisms.

papers.title: Semi-quantitative ultrasound scoring reveals hepatic structural recovery and immune modulation during tenofovir alafenamide therapy in chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system, and to investigate the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. Methods A total of 100 CHB patients who received TAF monotherapy (25 mg/day) for at least 24 months were retrospectively enrolled. A seven-parameter semi-quantitative US score, encompassing liver echogenicity, capsular contour, margin shape, vessel clarity, portal vein diameter (PVD), spleen thickness (ST), and splenic vein velocity (SVV), was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Concurrently, serum hepatitis B virus (HBV) deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), peripheral T-cell subsets, including cluster of differentiation 3-positive (CD3 + ), CD4 + , CD8 + T cells, CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and natural killer (NK) cell activity were measured. Correlations between US scores and biochemical/immune parameters were analyzed. Results At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The comprehensive US score decreased significantly from 7.86 ± 1.73 at baseline to 3.37 ± 0.95 at 24 months ( P < 0.001), with the most pronounced improvements observed in capsular smoothness and parenchymal homogeneity. The CD4 + T-cell proportion and CD4 + /CD8 + ratio increased, whereas the CD8 + proportion decreased; NK cell activity rose from 42.7 ± 7.3% to 52.4 ± 6.2% ( P < 0.05). The US score was positively correlated with ALT (r = 0.56) and AST (r = 0.47), and negatively correlated with the CD4 + /CD8 + ratio (r = −0.46) and NK cell activity (r = −0.38) (all P < 0.01). Conclusion These findings indicate that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalises liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement, as reflected by declining semi-quantitative US scores. The strong correlations of US scores with biochemical and immune parameters support its utility as a non-invasive imaging biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system. It aimed to assess the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. A total of 100 CHB patients on TAF monotherapy for at least 24 months were enrolled. The US score, which included seven parameters, was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Serum HBV DNA, ALT, AST, and immune parameters were also measured. At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The US score significantly decreased, indicating structural liver improvement. The US score correlated positively with ALT and AST and negatively with CD4+/CD8+ ratio and NK cell activity. These findings suggest that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalizes liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement. The strong correlations support the use of US as a non-invasive biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of reported limitations.

papers.title_zh: 半定量超声评分揭示慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)在接受替诺福韦艾拉酚胺治疗期间肝脏结构恢复和免疫调节
papers.source_body_en: Objective This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system, and to investigate the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. Methods A total of 100 CHB patients who received TAF monotherapy (25 mg/day) for at least 24 months were retrospectively enrolled. A seven-parameter semi-quantitative US score, encompassing liver echogenicity, capsular contour, margin shape, vessel clarity, portal vein diameter (PVD), spleen thickness (ST), and splenic vein velocity (SVV), was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Concurrently, serum hepatitis B virus (HBV) deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), peripheral T-cell subsets, including cluster of differentiation 3-positive (CD3 + ), CD4 + , CD8 + T cells, CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and natural killer (NK) cell activity were measured. Correlations between US scores and biochemical/immune parameters were analyzed. Results At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The comprehensive US score decreased significantly from 7.86 ± 1.73 at baseline to 3.37 ± 0.95 at 24 months ( P < 0.001), with the most pronounced improvements observed in capsular smoothness and parenchymal homogeneity. The CD4 + T-cell proportion and CD4 + /CD8 + ratio increased, whereas the CD8 + proportion decreased; NK cell activity rose from 42.7 ± 7.3% to 52.4 ± 6.2% ( P < 0.05). The US score was positively correlated with ALT (r = 0.56) and AST (r = 0.47), and negatively correlated with the CD4 + /CD8 + ratio (r = −0.46) and NK cell activity (r = −0.38) (all P < 0.01). Conclusion These findings indicate that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalises liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement, as reflected by declining semi-quantitative US scores. The strong correlations of US scores with biochemical and immune parameters support its utility as a non-invasive imaging biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在利用半定量超声(US)评分系统评估替诺福韦艾拉酚胺二甲基磺酸盐(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)患者中的治疗反应,并探讨超声影像变化与免疫功能恢复之间的相关性。方法 入选了100例接受TAF单药治疗(25 mg/天)至少24个月的慢性乙型肝炎患者进行回顾性分析。在基线、12个月和24个月时计算了包含肝脏回声、包膜轮廓、边缘形态、血管清晰度、门静脉直径(PVD)、脾脏厚度(ST)和脾静脉血流速度(SVV)的七参数半定量超声评分。同时测量了血清乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)脱氧核糖核酸(DNA)、丙氨酸氨基转移酶(ALT)、天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶(AST)以及外周T细胞亚群,包括分化簇3阳性(CD3+)、CD4+、CD8+ T细胞、CD4+/CD8+比值和自然杀伤(NK)细胞活性。分析了超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的相关性。结果 在24个月时,所有患者均达到HBV DNA <20 IU/mL,ALT和AST的正常化率分别为92%和95%。综合超声评分从基线的7.86 ± 1.73显著下降至24个月的3.37 ± 0.95(P < 0.001),其中包膜平滑度和实质均匀性的改善最为显著。CD4+ T细胞比例和CD4+/CD8+比值增加,而CD8+ T细胞比例下降;NK细胞活性从42.7 ± 7.3%上升至52.4 ± 6.2%(P < 0.05)。超声评分与ALT(r = 0.56)和AST(r = 0.47)呈正相关,与CD4+/CD8+比值(r = −0.46)和NK细胞活性(r = −0.38)呈负相关(所有P < 0.01)。结论 这些发现表明,TAF不仅抑制病毒复制并使肝酶正常化,还促进可测量的肝脏结构改善,这体现在半定量超声评分的下降。超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的强相关性支持其作为非侵入性影像生物标志物用于监测治疗疗效和肝脏修复的潜力。

papers.title: Hepatitis B vaccination and neonatal mortality in the United States
papers.abstract: We estimate the plausibly causal effect of hepatitis B birth dose vaccination on neonatal mortality using U.S. county-level panel data (2011–2019) and a shift-share instrument that interacts historical fertility rates with national vaccine price variation. With county fixed effects and a control for the historical fertility share interacted with a linear trend, a one percentage point increase in birth dose coverage reduces 0–3 day mortality by 0.022 deaths per 1,000 live births, representing a 1.04% decline at the mean. The effect is concentrated in the first day of life and is indistinguishable from zero at later infant ages, a profile consistent either with an early life mechanism or with an administrative one, and we identify neither. The estimate is an unweighted county average conditional on a linear fertility trend, and we report the diagnostics that qualify it alongside those that support it.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the causal effect of hepatitis B birth dose vaccination on neonatal mortality in the United States using county-level panel data from 2011 to 2019. The researchers employed a shift-share instrument that combines historical fertility rates with national vaccine price variation. They found that a one percentage point increase in birth dose coverage reduces 0–3 day mortality by 0.022 deaths per 1,000 live births, representing a 1.04% decline at the mean. The effect is most pronounced on the first day of life, with no significant impact observed at later infant ages. However, the study's results are based on an unweighted county average and rely on diagnostics that support the estimate. The evidence is considered moderate in strength due to the limitations of the methodology and the potential for confounding factors.

papers.title: Exploratory associations of gut microbiota composition with HBeAg and HBsAg status in nucleos(t)ide analog-treated chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT HBeAg and HBsAg reflect viral replication and host immune status and are important determinants of treatment responsiveness in chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The gut microbiota, a key component of the gut-liver axis, may influence immune regulation and antiviral outcomes. This study characterized gut microbiota profiles across different HBeAg and HBsAg statuses in CHB patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy. Fecal shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed in 29 healthy controls (HC) and 101 NA-treated CHB patients without cirrhosis or hepatocellular carcinoma, including 30 HBeAg-positive (EP) and 71 HBeAg-negative (EN) individuals. The EN group was further stratified by serum HBsAg levels into an advantageous subgroup (<1,500 IU/mL, n = 57) and a non-advantageous subgroup (≥1,500 IU/mL, n = 14). Alpha and beta diversity did not differ significantly among EP, EN, and HC groups. Species-level analyses identified nominal group-related differences in several Bacteroidales- and Firmicutes-associated anaerobic commensals, including Bacteroides uniformis, Blautia obeum, Eubacterium ventriosum, Anaerobutyricum, and Parabacteroides timonensis; however, none remained significant after global FDR correction across all detected species. Within the EN group, selected taxa showed directionally consistent associations with HBsAg strata in downsampling, leave-one-out, and CLR-based sensitivity analyses, but these subgroup findings also did not remain significant after FDR correction. NA-treated CHB was associated with exploratory taxonomic differences without detectable loss of microbial diversity. The observed associations with HBeAg status and HBsAg burden were hypothesis-generating and require validation in larger longitudinal cohorts incorporating absolute microbial quantification, targeted metabolomics, host immune profiling, and more complete dietary, anthropometric, and other relevant clinical covariates.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore the associations between gut microbiota composition and HBeAg and HBsAg status in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) receiving nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy, as these markers reflect viral replication and host immune status and are critical for treatment responsiveness.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed gut microbiota profiles in 29 healthy controls (HC) and 101 NA-treated CHB patients without cirrhosis or hepatocellular carcinoma, including 30 HBeAg-positive (EP) and 71 HBeAg-negative (EN) individuals. The EN group was further stratified by serum HBsAg levels into an advantageous subgroup (<1,500 IU/mL, n = 57) and a non-advantageous subgroup (≥1,500 IU/mL, n = 14).
analysis.methods: Fecal shotgun metagenomic sequencing was used to characterize gut microbiota profiles across different HBeAg and HBsAg statuses in CHB patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy.
analysis.main_results: Alpha and beta diversity did not differ significantly among EP, EN, and HC groups. Species-level analyses identified nominal group-related differences in several Bacteroidales- and Firmicutes-associated anaerobic commensals, but none remained significant after global FDR correction. Within the EN group, selected taxa showed directionally consistent associations with HBsAg strata in various sensitivity analyses, but these findings also did not remain significant after FDR correction.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The observed associations with HBeAg status and HBsAg burden were hypothesis-generating and suggest potential links between gut microbiota and viral outcomes in CHB patients, though further validation is needed.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may inform future research on the role of gut microbiota in CHB progression and treatment response, potentially guiding the development of microbiota-based biomarkers or interventions.

analysis.summary_en: This study explored the associations between gut microbiota composition and HBeAg and HBsAg status in nucleos(t)ide analog-treated chronic hepatitis B patients. The research aimed to understand how gut microbiota might influence immune regulation and antiviral outcomes in CHB. Using fecal shotgun metagenomic sequencing, the study analyzed 29 healthy controls and 101 CHB patients, including 30 HBeAg-positive and 71 HBeAg-negative individuals. The EN group was further divided based on HBsAg levels. While some nominal differences in microbial taxa were observed, none remained significant after FDR correction. Subgroup analyses within the EN group showed directionally consistent associations with HBsAg strata, but these were also not significant after correction. The findings are hypothesis-generating and suggest potential links between gut microbiota and viral outcomes in CHB, though they require validation in larger longitudinal studies. The study's limitations include the lack of statistical significance and insufficient clinical data, which reduce the strength of the evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨接受核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗的慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中肠道微生物群组成与HBeAg和HBsAg状态之间的关联,因为这些标志物反映了病毒复制和宿主免疫状态,并且对治疗应答至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了29名健康对照(HC)和101名无肝硬化或肝细胞癌的NA治疗CHB患者的肠道微生物群特征,其中包括30名HBeAg阳性(EP)和71名HBeAg阴性(EN)个体。EN组进一步根据血清HBsAg水平分为优势亚组(<1,500 IU/mL,n = 57)和非优势亚组(≥1,500 IU/mL,n = 14)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用粪便宏基因组 shotgun 测序来分析接受核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗的CHB患者中不同HBeAg和HBsAg状态下的肠道微生物群特征。
elements_zh.main_results: EP、EN和HC组的α多样性和β多样性均无显著差异。种群水平分析发现,与Bacteroidales和Firmicutes相关的厌氧共生菌存在组间差异,但这些差异在全局FDR校正后均不显著。在EN组中,选定的菌群在下采样、留一法和CLR基础上的敏感性分析中显示出方向一致的关联,但这些发现同样在FDR校正后不显著。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 观察到的与HBeAg状态和HBsAg负担的关联具有假设生成性,提示肠道微生物群可能与CHB患者的病毒结果存在潜在联系,但需要进一步验证。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来研究肠道微生物群在CHB进展和治疗应答中的作用提供信息,可能有助于开发基于微生物群的生物标志物或干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 观察到的关联在FDR校正后均不具有统计学意义,且本研究缺乏纵向数据、绝对微生物定量以及全面的临床协变量,限制了证据的强度。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 HBeAg和HBsAg反映了病毒复制和宿主免疫状态,是治疗应答的重要决定因素。肠道微生物群作为肠道-肝脏轴的关键组成部分,可能影响免疫调节和抗病毒药物结果。本研究分析了接受核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗的慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中不同HBeAg和HBsAg状态下的肠道微生物群特征。对29名健康对照(HC)和101名无肝硬化或肝细胞癌的NA治疗CHB患者进行了粪便宏基因组 shotgun 测序,其中包括30名HBeAg阳性(EP)和71名HBeAg阴性(EN)个体。EN组进一步根据血清HBsAg水平分为优势亚组(<1,500 IU/mL,n = 57)和非优势亚组(≥1,500 IU/mL,n = 14)。EP、EN和HC组的α多样性和β多样性均无显著差异。种群水平分析发现,与Bacteroidales和Firmicutes相关的厌氧共生菌存在组间差异,包括Bacteroides uniformis、Blautia obeum、Eubacterium ventriosum、Anaerobutyricum和Parabacteroides timonensis;然而,在所有检测到的物种中,这些差异在全局FDR校正后均不显著。在EN组中,选定的菌群在下采样、留一法和CLR基础上的敏感性分析中显示出方向一致的关联,但这些亚组发现同样在FDR校正后不显著。接受NA治疗的CHB患者与肠道微生物群的探索性分类差异相关,但未观察到微生物多样性的明显损失。观察到的与HBeAg状态和HBsAg负担的关联具有假设生成性,需要在更大规模的纵向队列研究研究中进行验证,该研究应纳入绝对微生物定量、靶向代谢组学、宿主免疫表型以及更全面的饮食、人体测量和其他相关临床协变量。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了29名健康对照(HC)和101名无肝硬化或肝细胞癌的NA治疗CHB患者的肠道微生物群特征,其中包括30名HBeAg阳性(EP)和71名HBeAg阴性(EN)个体。EN组进一步根据血清HBsAg水平分为优势亚组(<1,500 IU/mL,n = 57)和非优势亚组(≥1,500 IU/mL,n = 14)。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用粪便宏基因组 shotgun 测序来分析接受核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗的CHB患者中不同HBeAg和HBsAg状态下的肠道微生物群特征。
analysis_zh.main_results: EP、EN和HC组的α多样性和β多样性均无显著差异。种群水平分析发现,与Bacteroidales和Firmicutes相关的厌氧共生菌存在组间差异,但这些差异在全局FDR校正后均不显著。在EN组中,选定的菌群在下采样、留一法和CLR基础上的敏感性分析中显示出方向一致的关联,但这些发现同样在FDR校正后不显著。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 观察到的与HBeAg状态和HBsAg负担的关联具有假设生成性,提示肠道微生物群可能与CHB患者的病毒结果存在潜在联系,但需要进一步验证。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来研究肠道微生物群在CHB进展和治疗应答中的作用提供信息,可能有助于开发基于微生物群的生物标志物或干预措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 观察到的关联在FDR校正后均不具有统计学意义,且本研究缺乏纵向数据、绝对微生物定量以及全面的临床协变量,限制了证据的强度。

papers.title: A dual recombinant strategy to quantify PreS1 antibody in hepatitis B patients with genotype B or C virus by ELISA
papers.abstract: Elevated levels of anti-preS1 antibodies in patients correlate with faster hepatitis B virus (HBV) clearance, since preS1 is vital for viral entry. However, accurate quantification of preS1 antibodies is hindered by the variation of HBV genotypes. Herein, a quantitative preS1 antibody assay was developed for Chinese patients with predominant HBV genotypes B and C. First, to address genotype diversity, we constructed a dual recombinant protein combining genotype B and C preS1. Second, a mouse-human chimeric antibody with high and comparable affinity for both B and C preS1 is developed as the standard for quantification by screening and cloning. An optimized ELISA kit using these components demonstrated good specificity, accuracy, reproducibility and stability, with a linear range of 10–100 ng/mL. This approach extends the patient coverage in China to over 95%, providing a valuable diagnostic tool. This work demonstrates a proof-of-concept model for developing broad-coverage assays for other multi-genotype viral diseases.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a quantitative preS1 antibody assay for Chinese patients infected with HBV genotypes B and C. The researchers constructed a dual recombinant protein combining preS1 from both genotypes and developed a mouse-human chimeric antibody as a standard for quantification. An optimized ELISA kit using these components showed good specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and stability, with a linear range of 10–100 ng/mL. The assay extends patient coverage in China to over 95%, offering a valuable diagnostic tool. The study presents a proof-of-concept model for creating broad-coverage assays for other multi-genotype viral diseases. The findings suggest potential applications in monitoring immune responses and disease progression in HBV patients. However, the evidence does not report specific limitations or an assessment of the study's evidence strength.

papers.title_zh: 一种双重组策略用于通过ELISA定量乙型肝炎病毒基因型B或C患者的PreS1抗体
papers.source_body_en: Elevated levels of anti-preS1 antibodies in patients correlate with faster hepatitis B virus (HBV) clearance, since preS1 is vital for viral entry. However, accurate quantification of preS1 antibodies is hindered by the variation of HBV genotypes. Herein, a quantitative preS1 antibody assay was developed for Chinese patients with predominant HBV genotypes B and C. First, to address genotype diversity, we constructed a dual recombinant protein combining genotype B and C preS1. Second, a mouse-human chimeric antibody with high and comparable affinity for both B and C preS1 is developed as the standard for quantification by screening and cloning. An optimized ELISA kit using these components demonstrated good specificity, accuracy, reproducibility and stability, with a linear range of 10–100 ng/mL. This approach extends the patient coverage in China to over 95%, providing a valuable diagnostic tool. This work demonstrates a proof-of-concept model for developing broad-coverage assays for other multi-genotype viral diseases.
papers.abstract_zh: 患者体内抗PreS1抗体水平升高与更快的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)清除相关,因为PreS1对病毒进入至关重要。然而,由于HBV基因型的差异,准确量化PreS1抗体受到阻碍。本文开发了一种针对中国主要为基因型B和C的乙型肝炎病毒患者的定量PreS1抗体检测方法。首先,为应对基因型多样性,我们构建了一种结合基因型B和C PreS1的双重组蛋白。其次,通过筛选和克隆,开发了一种对B和C型PreS1具有高且可比亲和力的小鼠-人嵌合抗体,作为定量的标准。使用这些组分优化的ELISA试剂盒表现出良好的特异性、准确度、可重复性和稳定性,线性范围为10–100 ng/mL。该方法将中国患者的覆盖范围扩展至超过95%,提供了一种有价值的诊断工具。本研究展示了一种开发适用于其他多基因型病毒疾病的广泛覆盖检测方法的概念验证模型。

papers.title: Serum hepatitis B virus markers reflect intrahepatic covalently closed circular DNA and transcriptional activity across chronic hepatitis B phases
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA) maintains hepatitis B virus (HBV) persistence through its transcriptional activity.While cccDNA and pregenomic RNA (pgRNA) are central to HBV replication, serum markers reflecting active cccDNA remain poorly defined across the phases of chronic hepatitis B (CHB).AIM To identify serum markers reflecting intrahepatic cccDNA and its activity, we analyzed a large CHB cohort encompassing all immunological phases.METHODS Samples from 406 treatment-naïve CHB patients were analyzed by disease phase, including 56 hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg)-positive chronic HBV infection (EPCI), 153 HBeAg-positive-chronic hepatitis B (EPCH), 83 HBeAg-negative chronic HBV infection (ENCI), and 114 HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B (ENCH).Serum markers [hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis B core-related antigen (HBcrAg), and HBV RNA]and intrahepatic markers (cccDNA and pgRNA) were quantified with commercial assays.Transcriptional activity was evaluated in patients with comparable intrahepatic cccDNA levels. RESULTSAll serum and intrahepatic markers were inversely associated with age and were higher in HBeAg-positive than in HBeAg-negative patients.Correlations among serum and intrahepatic markers appeared higher in HBeAg-positive patients.Serum markers correlated more closely with pgRNA than with cccDNA.Serum HBcrAg and HBV RNA better reflected intrahepatic markers than HBsAg.Among 120 patients with comparable 5 / 34 cccDNA levels, intrahepatic cccDNA transcriptional activity (pgRNA/cccDNA) varied across CHB phases: Highest in EPCI, lowest in ENCI, moderate in EPCH, and reelevated in ENCH.HBcrAg and HBV RNA showed stronger associations with cccDNA transcriptional activity than HBsAg across the EPCH and ENCH phases.Notably, no serum marker reliably reflected pgRNA or transcriptional activity in the ENCI phase. CONCLUSIONHBcrAg and HBV RNA are phase-dependent surrogates of transcriptionally active cccDNA.The lack of reliable markers in ENCI highlights its virologic heterogeneity.These findings support phase-specific monitoring and treatment decisions.

source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND Covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA) maintains hepatitis B virus (HBV) persistence through its transcriptional activity.While cccDNA and pregenomic RNA (pgRNA) are central to HBV replication, serum markers reflecting active cccDNA remain poorly defined across the phases of chronic hepatitis B (CHB).AIM To identify serum markers reflecting intrahepatic cccDNA and its activity, we analyzed a large CHB cohort encompassing all immunological phases.METHODS Samples from 406 treatment-naïve CHB patients were analyzed by disease phase, including 56 hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg)-positive chronic HBV infection (EPCI), 153 HBeAg-positive-chronic hepatitis B (EPCH), 83 HBeAg-negative chronic HBV infection (ENCI), and 114 HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B (ENCH).Serum markers [hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis B core-related antigen (HBcrAg), and HBV RNA]and intrahepatic markers (cccDNA and pgRNA) were quantified with commercial assays.Transcriptional activity was evaluated in patients with comparable intrahepatic cccDNA levels. RESULTSAll serum and intrahepatic markers were inversely associated with age and were higher in HBeAg-positive than in HBeAg-negative patients.Correlations among serum and intrahepatic markers appeared higher in HBeAg-positive patients.Serum markers correlated more closely with pgRNA than with cccDNA.Serum HBcrAg and HBV RNA better reflected intrahepatic markers than HBsAg.Among 120 patients with comparable 5 / 34 cccDNA levels, intrahepatic cccDNA transcriptional activity (pgRNA/cccDNA) varied across CHB phases: Highest in EPCI, lowest in ENCI, moderate in EPCH, and reelevated in ENCH.HBcrAg and HBV RNA showed stronger associations with cccDNA transcriptional activity than HBsAg across the EPCH and ENCH phases.Notably, no serum marker reliably reflected pgRNA or transcriptional activity in the ENCI phase. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify serum markers reflecting intrahepatic cccDNA and its transcriptional activity across the phases of chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The background highlights the need for better understanding of serum markers that correlate with cccDNA, which is central to HBV persistence.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed samples from 406 treatment-naïve CHB patients, categorized by immunological phases: 56 HBeAg-positive chronic HBV infection (EPCI), 153 HBeAg-positive chronic hepatitis B (EPCH), 83 HBeAg-negative chronic HBV infection (ENCI), and 114 HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B (ENCH).
analysis.methods: Serum markers [HBsAg, HBcrAg, and HBV RNA] and intrahepatic markers (cccDNA and pgRNA) were quantified using commercial assays. Transcriptional activity was evaluated in patients with comparable intrahepatic cccDNA levels.
analysis.main_results: All serum and intrahepatic markers were inversely associated with age and higher in HBeAg-positive than in HBeAg-negative patients. Serum HBcrAg and HBV RNA showed stronger associations with cccDNA transcriptional activity than HBsAg across the EPCH and ENCH phases. Notably, no serum marker reliably reflected pgRNA or transcriptional activity in the ENCI phase.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that HBcrAg and HBV RNA are phase-dependent surrogates of transcriptionally active cccDNA, while the lack of reliable markers in ENCI highlights its virologic heterogeneity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support the use of phase-specific monitoring and treatment decisions for chronic hepatitis B, emphasizing the importance of selecting appropriate serum markers for different disease phases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on commercial assays and the focus on a single cohort. The evidence is moderate, as the results are based on correlations rather than direct causation.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to identify serum markers reflecting intrahepatic cccDNA and its transcriptional activity across the phases of chronic hepatitis B. It analyzed a cohort of 406 treatment-naïve patients categorized by immunological phases. Serum markers such as HBcrAg and HBV RNA showed stronger associations with cccDNA transcriptional activity than HBsAg, particularly in HBeAg-positive phases. However, no serum marker reliably reflected pgRNA or transcriptional activity in the HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B phase. The authors concluded that HBcrAg and HBV RNA are phase-dependent surrogates of transcriptionally active cccDNA, highlighting the virologic heterogeneity in ENCI. These findings support the need for phase-specific monitoring and treatment decisions. The study's evidence is moderate due to its reliance on correlations and a single cohort.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在识别反映慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)各阶段肝内共价闭合环状DNA及其转录活性的血清标志物。背景强调了更好地理解与共价闭合环状DNA相关的血清标志物的重要性,因为共价闭合环状DNA是HBV持续感染的核心。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了406名未接受治疗治疗的CHB患者的样本,按免疫学阶段分类:56例HBeAg阳性慢性HBV感染(EPCI)、153例HBeAg阳性慢性乙型肝炎(EPCH)、83例HBeAg阴性慢性HBV感染(ENCI)和114例HBeAg阴性慢性乙型肝炎(ENCH)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用商业检测方法量化血清标志物(HBsAg、HBcrAg和HBV RNA)以及肝内标志物(共价闭合环状DNA和pgRNA)。在肝内共价闭合环状DNA水平相似的患者中评估转录活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有血清和肝内标志物均与年龄呈负相关,且HBeAg阳性患者的水平高于HBeAg阴性患者。在EPCH和ENCH阶段,血清HBcrAg和HBV RNA与共价闭合环状DNA的转录活性关联比HBsAg更强。值得注意的是,在ENCI阶段,没有血清标志物能可靠反映pgRNA或转录活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,HBcrAg和HBV RNA是共价闭合环状DNA转录活性的阶段依赖性替代标志物,而ENCI阶段缺乏可靠标志物突显了其病毒学异质性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在不同疾病阶段进行阶段特异性监测和治疗决策,强调了选择适当血清标志物的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖商业检测方法,并且仅针对单一队列研究进行分析。证据强度中等,因为结果基于相关性而非直接因果关系。

RESULTSAll serum and intrahepatic markers were inversely associated with age and were higher in HBeAg-positive than in HBeAg-negative patients.Correlations among serum and intrahepatic markers appeared higher in HBeAg-positive patients.Serum markers correlated more closely with pgRNA than with cccDNA.Serum HBcrAg and HBV RNA better reflected intrahepatic markers than HBsAg.Among 120 patients with comparable 5 / 34 cccDNA levels, intrahepatic cccDNA transcriptional activity (pgRNA/cccDNA) varied across CHB phases: Highest in EPCI, lowest in ENCI, moderate in EPCH, and reelevated in ENCH.HBcrAg and HBV RNA showed stronger associations with cccDNA transcriptional activity than HBsAg across the EPCH and ENCH phases.Notably, no serum marker reliably reflected pgRNA or transcriptional activity in the ENCI phase. CONCLUSIONHBcrAg and HBV RNA are phase-dependent surrogates of transcriptionally active cccDNA.The lack of reliable markers in ENCI highlights its virologic heterogeneity.These findings support phase-specific monitoring and treatment decisions.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 共价闭合环状DNA(共价闭合环状DNA)通过其转录活性维持乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)的持续感染。尽管共价闭合环状DNA和前基因组RNA(pgRNA)是HBV复制的核心,但反映共价闭合环状DNA活性的血清标志物在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)各阶段仍不明确。目的 为了识别反映肝内共价闭合环状DNA及其活性的血清标志物,我们分析了一组涵盖所有免疫学阶段的CHB患者队列。方法 对406名未接受治疗治疗的CHB患者按疾病阶段进行分析,包括56例乙肝e抗原(HBeAg)阳性慢性HBV感染(EPCI)、153例HBeAg阳性慢性乙型肝炎(EPCH)、83例HBeAg阴性慢性HBV感染(ENCI)和114例HBeAg阴性慢性乙型肝炎(ENCH)。使用商业检测方法量化血清标志物(乙肝表面抗原(HBsAg)、乙肝核心相关抗原(HBcrAg)和HBV RNA)以及肝内标志物(共价闭合环状DNA和pgRNA)。在肝内共价闭合环状DNA水平相似的患者中评估转录活性。结果 所有血清和肝内标志物均与年龄呈负相关,且HBeAg阳性患者的水平高于HBeAg阴性患者。血清和肝内标志物之间的相关性在HBeAg阳性患者中更为显著。血清标志物与pgRNA的相关性比与共价闭合环状DNA的相关性更紧密。血清HBcrAg和HBV RNA比HBsAg更能反映共价闭合环状DNA的转录活性。在5/34具有相似共价闭合环状DNA水平的120例患者中,肝内共价闭合环状DNA的转录活性(pgRNA/共价闭合环状DNA)在CHB各阶段有所不同:EPCI阶段最高,ENCI阶段最低,EPCH阶段中等,ENCH阶段再次升高。HBcrAg和HBV RNA在EPCH和ENCH阶段与共价闭合环状DNA的转录活性关联更强。值得注意的是,在ENCI阶段,没有血清标志物能可靠反映pgRNA或转录活性。结论 HBcrAg和HBV RNA是共价闭合环状DNA转录活性的阶段依赖性替代标志物。ENCI阶段缺乏可靠的标志物突显了其病毒学异质性。这些发现支持针对不同疾病阶段进行阶段特异性监测和治疗决策。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在识别反映慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)各阶段肝内共价闭合环状DNA及其转录活性的血清标志物。背景强调了更好地理解与共价闭合环状DNA相关的血清标志物的重要性,因为共价闭合环状DNA是HBV持续感染的核心。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了406名未接受治疗治疗的CHB患者的样本,按免疫学阶段分类:56例HBeAg阳性慢性HBV感染(EPCI)、153例HBeAg阳性慢性乙型肝炎(EPCH)、83例HBeAg阴性慢性HBV感染(ENCI)和114例HBeAg阴性慢性乙型肝炎(ENCH)。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用商业检测方法量化血清标志物(HBsAg、HBcrAg和HBV RNA)以及肝内标志物(共价闭合环状DNA和pgRNA)。在肝内共价闭合环状DNA水平相似的患者中评估转录活性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 所有血清和肝内标志物均与年龄呈负相关,且HBeAg阳性患者的水平高于HBeAg阴性患者。在EPCH和ENCH阶段,血清HBcrAg和HBV RNA与共价闭合环状DNA的转录活性关联比HBsAg更强。值得注意的是,在ENCI阶段,没有血清标志物能可靠反映pgRNA或转录活性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,HBcrAg和HBV RNA是共价闭合环状DNA转录活性的阶段依赖性替代标志物,而ENCI阶段缺乏可靠标志物突显了其病毒学异质性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在不同疾病阶段进行阶段特异性监测和治疗决策,强调了选择适当血清标志物的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖商业检测方法,并且仅针对单一队列研究进行分析。证据强度中等,因为结果基于相关性而非直接因果关系。

papers.title: Outcomes of hepatitis B and hepatitis delta infection in hospitalized pregnant women in the United States: a nationwide study, 1998–2022
papers.abstract: Hepatitis delta (HDV) is a severe viral hepatitis disease that occurs only in individuals with hepatitis B (HBV). In the pregnant population, HDV has been scarcely studied, and no guidance exists for its management. We aim to describe and compare a cohort of pregnant women with concurrent HBV/HDV infection to a cohort of pregnant women with only HBV. Utilizing the National Inpatient Sample, a database of hospitalizations throughout the United States, we extracted data from 1998 to 2022 on pregnant women with HBV and HDV using ICD-9 and ICD-10 codes. Demographics and clinical data including co-infection, comorbid condition, pregnancy complications, fetal outcomes, and mortality were collected. Analysis was performed using chi-square and logistic regression. We identified 390 pregnancies with HDV and 127,332 with HBV only. In the HDV cohort, median age was 30 years, and the predominant ethnicity/race was Asian or Pacific Islander at 27.4%. There were no cases of maternal deaths in the HDV group. Rates of hepatitis C (12.1% vs. Of those with HDV, 318 (81.5%) had known delivery. Rates of stillbirth were significantly higher in the HDV cohort (2.8% vs. Rates of preterm and post-term birth were similar ( p > 0.05). HDV remains uncommon in pregnancy but is likely under-recognized. Pregnancies affected by concurrent HBV/HDV infection may carry a higher risk of adverse fetal outcomes, particularly stillbirth, compared to HBV alone.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight the need for improved recognition and management of HDV in pregnant women to reduce the risk of stillbirth and other adverse outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the outcomes of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis delta virus (HDV) infections in hospitalized pregnant women in the United States from 1998 to 2022. It aimed to address the lack of guidance on managing HDV in this population, as HDV is a severe viral hepatitis that occurs only in individuals with HBV. Using the National Inpatient Sample database, the researchers compared demographic and clinical data between pregnant women with concurrent HBV/HDV infection and those with HBV alone. They identified 390 pregnancies with HDV and 127,332 with HBV only. Stillbirth rates were significantly higher in the HDV cohort (2.8% vs. 0.5%), while preterm and post-term birth rates were similar. The findings suggest that concurrent HBV/HDV infection may be associated with an increased risk of stillbirth. These results emphasize the importance of recognizing HDV in pregnant women to improve maternal and fetal outcomes. The study's reliance on administrative data limits its depth, and the evidence is considered moderate due to its observational design.

papers.abstract_zh: 丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)是一种严重的病毒性肝炎,仅发生在乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染者中。在孕妇人群中,HDV的研究非常有限,且目前尚无相关管理指南。本研究旨在描述并比较同时感染HBV/HDV的孕妇与仅感染HBV的孕妇的临床结局。利用美国全国住院样本数据库,我们提取了1998年至2022年间患有HBV和HDV的孕妇数据,使用的是ICD-9和ICD-10编码。收集了包括共感染、合并疾病、妊娠并发症、胎儿结局和死亡率在内的流行病学和临床数据。分析采用卡方检验和逻辑回归分析。我们确定了390例HDV感染的妊娠和127,332例仅HBV感染的妊娠。在HDV感染的孕妇中,中位年龄为30岁,主要人种/种族为亚洲或太平洋岛屿居民,占27.4%。HDV组中没有产妇死亡病例。HDV感染孕妇的肝炎C病毒感染率(12.1%)高于仅HBV感染孕妇(318例中81.5%已知分娩)。HDV感染孕妇的死产率显著高于仅HBV感染孕妇(2.8% vs. 0.5%),而早产和过期产率相似(p > 0.05)。HDV在妊娠中仍较为罕见,但可能被低估。同时感染HBV/HDV的妊娠可能比仅HBV感染的妊娠具有更高的不良胎儿结局风险,尤其是死产。

papers.title: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen and Hepatitis C Antibody Seroprevalence Among Male Blood Donors in Lahore, Pakistan: A Cross-Sectional Study at Four Blood Banks
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) pose important challenges to blood safety, highlighting the need for continued surveillance among blood donors. This cross-sectional study assessed the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and anti-HCV antibodies among male blood donors at four blood banks in Lahore, Pakistan, and examined their associations with age and ABO/Rh blood group. A total of 600 donors were included, with 150 recruited from each of General Hospital Lahore, Services Hospital Lahore, Noor Thalassaemia Centre, and Zaib Ali Foundation. Serum samples were screened using immunochromatographic rapid tests. Seroprevalence estimates were calculated with 95% Wilson confidence intervals (CIs). Associations with blood group were assessed using chi-square tests, and age distributions were compared using the Mann–Whitney U test. Statistical significance was defined as a two-sided p < 0.05. HBsAg seroprevalence was 4.8% (29/600; 95% CI, 3.4–6.9%), and anti-HCV seroprevalence was 4.5% (27/600; 95% CI, 3.1–6.5%). B-positive was the most frequent blood group (33.0%). Neither HBsAg nor anti-HCV reactivity was significantly associated with ABO/Rh blood group (χ2 = 10.17, p = 0.179 and χ2 = 4.16, p = 0.762, respectively). Age distributions did not differ significantly between reactive and nonreactive donors for either marker (p = 0.210 and p = 0.922, respectively). No significant association was observed between HBsAg and anti-HCV reactivity (p = 0.858). Approximately one in twenty donors screened reactive for each marker, underscoring the importance of reliable donor screening, appropriate confirmatory testing, donor counselling and referral. These findings represent screening-marker seroprevalence rather than confirmed active infection and should be interpreted within the limitations of rapid testing and the sampled male donor population.

papers.abstract_original: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) pose important challenges to blood safety, highlighting the need for continued surveillance among blood donors. This cross-sectional study assessed the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and anti-HCV antibodies among male blood donors at four blood banks in Lahore, Pakistan, and examined their associations with age and ABO/Rh blood group. A total of 600 donors were included, with 150 recruited from each of General Hospital Lahore, Services Hospital Lahore, Noor Thalassaemia Centre, and Zaib Ali Foundation. Serum samples were screened using immunochromatographic rapid tests. Seroprevalence estimates were calculated with 95% Wilson confidence intervals (CIs). Associations with blood group were assessed using chi-square tests, and age distributions were compared using the Mann–Whitney U test. Statistical significance was defined as a two-sided p < 0.05. HBsAg seroprevalence was 4.8% (29/600; 95% CI, 3.4–6.9%), and anti-HCV seroprevalence was 4.5% (27/600; 95% CI, 3.1–6.5%). B-positive was the most frequent blood group (33.0%). Neither HBsAg nor anti-HCV reactivity was significantly associated with ABO/Rh blood group (χ2 = 10.17, p = 0.179 and χ2 = 4.16, p = 0.762, respectively). Age distributions did not differ significantly between reactive and nonreactive donors for either marker (p = 0.210 and p = 0.922, respectively). No significant association was observed between HBsAg and anti-HCV reactivity (p = 0.858). Approximately one in twenty donors screened reactive for each marker, underscoring the importance of reliable donor screening, appropriate confirmatory testing, donor counselling and referral. These findings represent screening-marker seroprevalence rather than confirmed active infection and should be interpreted within the limitations of rapid testing and the sampled male donor population.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to assess the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and anti-HCV antibodies among male blood donors in Lahore, Pakistan, to address the challenges these viruses pose to blood safety.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted at four blood banks in Lahore, Pakistan, involving 600 male blood donors, with 150 recruited from each institution.
analysis.methods: Serum samples were screened using immunochromatographic rapid tests, and associations with blood group were assessed using chi-square tests, while age distributions were compared using the Mann–Whitney U test.
analysis.main_results: HBsAg seroprevalence was 4.8% (29/600; 95% CI, 3.4–6.9%), and anti-HCV seroprevalence was 4.5% (27/600; 95% CI, 3.1–6.5%). Neither HBsAg nor anti-HCV reactivity was significantly associated with ABO/Rh blood group or age distribution.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that the seroprevalence of HBsAg and anti-HCV among male blood donors is relatively low, but they emphasize the importance of reliable screening and confirmatory testing.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight the need for continued donor screening and confirmatory testing to ensure blood safety, particularly in regions with limited resources.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to screening-marker seroprevalence and rapid testing, which may not confirm active infection. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the cross-sectional design and the focus on a specific donor population.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and anti-HCV antibodies among 600 male blood donors in Lahore, Pakistan. The study found HBsAg prevalence at 4.8% and anti-HCV prevalence at 4.5%, with no significant associations with blood group or age. The findings underscore the importance of reliable donor screening and confirmatory testing, as rapid tests may not definitively indicate active infection. The study's results are limited to screening data and are applicable to the sampled male donor population, suggesting moderate evidence strength.

papers.title: Interferon-based HBV function cure therapy reduces hepatocellular carcinoma risk in low-HBsAg chronic hepatitis B patients: a propensity-matched cohort study and dynamic prediction model
papers.abstract: Background Functional cure through HBsAg loss is a key treatment goal in chronic hepatitis B (CHB), yet its impact on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk remains incompletely characterized, especially when achieved via interferon (IFN)-based therapy. We aimed to evaluate the HCC risk reduction associated with IFN-based therapy in low-HBsAg CHB patients and develop a validated prediction model for this population. Methods We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 3,367 CHB patients with HBsAg <1,500 IU/mL, including 1,780 receiving IFN-based therapy and 1,587 on nucleos(t)ide analogue (NAs) monotherapy. Propensity score matching (PSM) was used to balance baseline characteristics. Cox regression and time-dependent ROC analyses were employed to develop a dynamic nomogram for HCC prediction. Results IFN-based therapy was associated with a significantly lower HCC incidence compared to NAs monotherapy (1.2% vs. 4.9%, p<0.001), with a hazard ratio of 3.03 (95% CI: 1.82–5.06) after PSM. The protective effect was most pronounced in cirrhotic patients (absolute risk reduction 8.8%, NNT = 11). A novel nomogram incorporating treatment modality, AFP, cirrhosis, age, and other variables demonstrated excellent predictive accuracy (5-year AUC: 0.888 in derivation, 0.956 in validation cohorts), outperforming existing HCC prediction models. Conclusions IFN-based therapy significantly reduces HCC risk in low-HBsAg CHB patients, particularly those with cirrhosis. We developed and validated a dynamic prediction model that may facilitate personalized surveillance and treatment decisions in functionally cured patients.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the impact of interferon-based therapy on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk in low-HBsAg chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients. A propensity-matched cohort study of 3,367 patients showed that IFN-based therapy significantly reduced HCC incidence compared to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) monotherapy (1.2% vs. 4.9%, p<0.001). A dynamic nomogram incorporating treatment modality, AFP, cirrhosis, age, and other variables demonstrated excellent predictive accuracy (5-year AUC: 0.888 in derivation, 0.956 in validation cohorts), outperforming existing HCC prediction models. The protective effect was most pronounced in cirrhotic patients, with an absolute risk reduction of 8.8% and a number needed to treat of 11. The study highlights the potential of IFN-based therapy to reduce HCC risk in low-HBsAg CHB patients, particularly those with cirrhosis, and suggests the utility of a personalized prediction model for surveillance and treatment decisions. However, the study is retrospective and relies on propensity score matching, which may not fully eliminate confounding, limiting the strength of the evidence to moderate.

elements_zh.methods: 倾向评分匹配(PSM)被用于平衡基线特征。采用Cox回归和时间依赖性ROC分析来构建用于肝细胞癌(HCC)预测的动态列线图。
elements_zh.main_results: 基于干扰素的治疗与核苷类似物单药治疗相比,与显著降低的HCC 发病率相关(1.2% vs. 4.9%,p<0.001),在PSM后,风险比为3.03(95% CI:1.82–5.06)。一个结合治疗模式、AFP、肝硬化、年龄及其他变量的新颖列线图显示出卓越的预测准确性(衍生集5年AUC:0.888,验证集5年AUC:0.956 队列研究),优于现有的HCC预测模型。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 基于干扰素的治疗显著降低低HBsAg水平慢性乙型肝炎患者患肝细胞癌的风险,尤其是那些伴有肝硬化的患者。我们开发并验证了一个动态预测模型,可能有助于功能性治愈患者进行个性化的监测和治疗决策。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为功能性治愈患者提供个性化的监测和治疗决策,可能改善与乙型肝炎病毒相关肝硬化的患者预后。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究为回顾性研究,依赖于倾向评分匹配,这可能无法完全消除混杂因素。由于研究的观察性质和潜在偏倚,证据等级为中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Functional cure through HBsAg loss is a key treatment goal in chronic hepatitis B (CHB), yet its impact on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk remains incompletely characterized, especially when achieved via interferon (IFN)-based therapy.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 3,367 CHB patients with HBsAg <1,500 IU/mL, including 1,780 receiving IFN-based therapy and 1,587 on nucleos(t)ide analogue (NAs) monotherapy.
analysis_en.methods: Propensity score matching (PSM) was used to balance baseline characteristics. Cox regression and time-dependent ROC analyses were employed to develop a dynamic nomogram for HCC prediction.
analysis_en.main_results: IFN-based therapy was associated with a significantly lower HCC incidence compared to NAs monotherapy (1.2% vs. 4.9%, p<0.001), with a hazard ratio of 3.03 (95% CI: 1.82–5.06) after PSM. A novel nomogram incorporating treatment modality, AFP, cirrhosis, age, and other variables demonstrated excellent predictive accuracy (5-year AUC: 0.888 in derivation, 0.956 in validation cohorts), outperforming existing HCC prediction models.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: IFN-based therapy significantly reduces HCC risk in low-HBsAg CHB patients, particularly those with cirrhosis. We developed and validated a dynamic prediction model that may facilitate personalized surveillance and treatment decisions in functionally cured patients.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform personalized surveillance and treatment decisions in functionally cured patients, potentially improving outcomes for those with HBV-related cirrhosis.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is retrospective and relies on propensity score matching, which may not fully eliminate confounding. The evidence is moderate due to the observational nature and potential biases.

papers.title_zh: 基于干扰素的乙型肝炎病毒功能性治愈治疗降低低HBsAg慢性乙型肝炎患者肝细胞癌风险:一项倾向匹配研究及动态预测模型
papers.source_body_en: Background Functional cure through HBsAg loss is a key treatment goal in chronic hepatitis B (CHB), yet its impact on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk remains incompletely characterized, especially when achieved via interferon (IFN)-based therapy. We aimed to evaluate the HCC risk reduction associated with IFN-based therapy in low-HBsAg CHB patients and develop a validated prediction model for this population. Methods We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 3,367 CHB patients with HBsAg <1,500 IU/mL, including 1,780 receiving IFN-based therapy and 1,587 on nucleos(t)ide analogue (NAs) monotherapy. Propensity score matching (PSM) was used to balance baseline characteristics. Cox regression and time-dependent ROC analyses were employed to develop a dynamic nomogram for HCC prediction. Results IFN-based therapy was associated with a significantly lower HCC incidence compared to NAs monotherapy (1.2% vs. 4.9%, p<0.001), with a hazard ratio of 3.03 (95% CI: 1.82–5.06) after PSM. The protective effect was most pronounced in cirrhotic patients (absolute risk reduction 8.8%, NNT = 11). A novel nomogram incorporating treatment modality, AFP, cirrhosis, age, and other variables demonstrated excellent predictive accuracy (5-year AUC: 0.888 in derivation, 0.956 in validation cohorts), outperforming existing HCC prediction models. Conclusions IFN-based therapy significantly reduces HCC risk in low-HBsAg CHB patients, particularly those with cirrhosis. We developed and validated a dynamic prediction model that may facilitate personalized surveillance and treatment decisions in functionally cured patients.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:通过HBsAg丢失实现功能性治愈是慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)治疗的关键目标,但其对肝细胞癌(HCC)风险的影响尚未完全阐明,尤其是在通过干扰素(IFN)为基础的治疗实现时。我们旨在评估IFN为基础的治疗在低HBsAg CHB患者中与HCC风险降低的相关性,并为这一人群开发一个经过验证的预测模型。方法:我们对3,367名HBsAg <1,500 IU/mL的CHB患者进行了回顾性研究,其中包括1,780名接受IFN为基础的治疗和1,587名接受核苷(酸)类似物(NAs)单药治疗的患者。使用倾向评分匹配(PSM)来平衡基线特征。采用Cox回归和时间依赖ROC分析来开发HCC的动态列线图预测模型。结果:与NAs单药治疗相比,IFN为基础的治疗与显著更低的HCC发生率相关(1.2% vs. 4.9%,p<0.001),在PSM后,风险比为3.03(95% CI:1.82–5.06)。保护效应在肝硬化患者中最为显著(绝对风险降低8.8%,NNT = 11)。一个结合治疗方式、AFP、肝硬化、年龄及其他变量的新列线图模型显示出出色的预测准确性(5年AUC:推导集为0.888,验证集为0.956),优于现有的HCC预测模型。结论:IFN为基础的治疗显著降低低HBsAg CHB患者的HCC风险,尤其是肝硬化患者。我们开发并验证了一个动态预测模型,可能有助于功能性治愈患者进行个性化的治疗和监测决策。科学及公共卫生意义:这些发现可能为功能性治愈患者提供个性化的治疗和监测决策,从而改善HBV相关肝硬化的患者预后。局限性及证据强度:该研究为回顾性研究,依赖于倾向评分匹配,可能无法完全消除混杂因素。由于研究的观察性质和潜在偏倚,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Concurrent Fabry disease and Hepatitis-B virus-associated IgA nephropathy: A case report with pain as a precursor
papers.abstract: We report a 35-year-old man with Fabry disease coexisting with Hepatitis-B virus (HBV)-associated IgA nephropathy who had been treated for “rheumatism” for many years. He presented with severe burning pain in his extremities, microscopic hematuria and nephrotic-range proteinuria, while kidney function was preserved. Autoimmune tests were negative, but HBV markers were positive. Renal biopsy showed IgA-dominant mesangial proliferative glomerulonephritis with mesangial HBsAg deposits, and electron microscopy revealed myelin-like inclusions in podocytes and tubules. Markedly reduced α-galactosidase A activity, elevated lyso-GL-3 and a splice-site GLA mutation confirmed Fabry disease. Treatment with renin-angiotensin blockade, entecavir and enzyme replacement improved pain and proteinuria and stabilized renal function. This case illustrates that Fabry disease coexisting with HBV-associated IgA nephropathy is uncommon and easily underdiagnosed, and that persistent neuropathic pain with proteinuria should prompt consideration of metabolic and genetic renal disorders.

analysis.methods: Autoimmune tests were performed, and HBV markers were assessed. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as an illustration of the uncommon coexistence of Fabry disease and HBV-associated IgA nephropathy, emphasizing the need for careful differential diagnosis in patients with persistent neuropathic pain and proteinuria.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that persistent neuropathic pain with proteinuria should prompt consideration of metabolic and genetic renal disorders, potentially informing more targeted diagnostic approaches in clinical practice.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable. The evidence is based on clinical observations and laboratory findings, providing a moderate level of confidence in the reported association.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在报告一例罕见的Fabry病与HBV相关IgA肾病并发病例,强调在出现持续性神经病理性疼痛和蛋白尿的患者中考虑代谢性和遗传性疾病的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对一例35岁同时患有Fabry病和HBV相关IgA肾病的男性患者进行了病例报告,该患者多年来被误诊为“风湿病”并接受治疗,且出现严重灼痛、显微镜下血尿和肾病范围蛋白尿,同时保持肾功能正常。
elements_zh.methods: 进行了自身免疫检测,并评估了HBV标志物。进行了肾活检和电镜检查以评估组织病理学特征,实验室检测通过α-半乳糖苷酶A活性降低、溶酶体GL-3水平升高以及剪接位点GLA突变确认了Fabry病的诊断。
elements_zh.main_results: 肾活检显示以IgA为主的系膜增生性肾小球肾炎,伴有系膜区HBsAg沉积,电镜检查发现足细胞和管型中存在类似髓鞘的包涵体。通过显著降低的α-半乳糖苷酶A活性、升高的溶酶体GL-3水平以及剪接位点GLA突变确认了Fabry病。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为Fabry病与HBV相关IgA肾病并发的罕见病例,强调在持续性神经病理性疼痛和蛋白尿患者中进行细致鉴别诊断的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,持续性神经病理性疼痛伴蛋白尿应提示考虑代谢性和遗传性肾脏疾病,这可能有助于在临床实践中采取更具针对性的诊断方法。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to report a rare case of concurrent Fabry disease and HBV-associated IgA nephropathy, highlighting the importance of considering metabolic and genetic disorders in patients presenting with persistent neuropathic pain and proteinuria.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A case report was conducted on a 35-year-old man with Fabry disease coexisting with HBV-associated IgA nephropathy, who had been treated for "rheumatism" for many years and presented with severe burning pain, microscopic hematuria, and nephrotic-range proteinuria while maintaining preserved kidney function.
analysis_en.methods: Autoimmune tests were performed, and HBV markers were assessed. Renal biopsy and electron microscopy were conducted to evaluate histopathological features, and laboratory tests confirmed Fabry disease through reduced α-galactosidase A activity, elevated lyso-GL-3 levels, and a splice-site GLA mutation.
analysis_en.main_results: Renal biopsy revealed IgA-dominant mesangial proliferative glomerulonephritis with mesangial HBsAg deposits, and electron microscopy showed myelin-like inclusions in podocytes and tubules. Fabry disease was confirmed by markedly reduced α-galactosidase A activity, elevated lyso-GL-3 and a splice-site GLA mutation.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as an illustration of the uncommon coexistence of Fabry disease and HBV-associated IgA nephropathy, emphasizing the need for careful differential diagnosis in patients with persistent neuropathic pain and proteinuria.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that persistent neuropathic pain with proteinuria should prompt consideration of metabolic and genetic renal disorders, potentially informing more targeted diagnostic approaches in clinical practice.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable. The evidence is based on clinical observations and laboratory findings, providing a moderate level of confidence in the reported association.

papers.title_zh: Fabry病与乙型肝炎病毒相关IgA肾病并发:以疼痛为前驱的病例报告
papers.source_body_en: We report a 35-year-old man with Fabry disease coexisting with Hepatitis-B virus (HBV)-associated IgA nephropathy who had been treated for “rheumatism” for many years. He presented with severe burning pain in his extremities, microscopic hematuria and nephrotic-range proteinuria, while kidney function was preserved. Autoimmune tests were negative, but HBV markers were positive. Renal biopsy showed IgA-dominant mesangial proliferative glomerulonephritis with mesangial HBsAg deposits, and electron microscopy revealed myelin-like inclusions in podocytes and tubules. Markedly reduced α-galactosidase A activity, elevated lyso-GL-3 and a splice-site GLA mutation confirmed Fabry disease. Treatment with renin-angiotensin blockade, entecavir and enzyme replacement improved pain and proteinuria and stabilized renal function. This case illustrates that Fabry disease coexisting with HBV-associated IgA nephropathy is uncommon and easily underdiagnosed, and that persistent neuropathic pain with proteinuria should prompt consideration of metabolic and genetic renal disorders.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一例35岁男性患者,其同时患有Fabry病和乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)相关的IgA肾病,且多年来被误诊为“风湿病”进行治疗。该患者出现四肢严重灼痛、显微镜下血尿和肾病范围蛋白尿,但肾功能保持正常。自身免疫检测为阴性,但HBV标志物为阳性。肾活检显示以IgA为主的系膜增生性肾小球肾炎,伴有系膜区HBsAg沉积,电镜检查发现足细胞和管型中存在类似髓鞘的包涵体。显著降低的α-半乳糖苷酶A活性、升高的溶酶体GL-3水平以及剪接位点GLA突变确认了Fabry病的诊断。使用肾素-血管紧张素阻断剂、恩替卡韦和酶替代治疗改善了疼痛和蛋白尿,并稳定了肾功能。该病例表明,Fabry病与HBV相关IgA肾病并发的情况较为罕见且容易被误诊,持续性神经病理性疼痛伴蛋白尿应提示考虑代谢性和遗传性肾脏疾病。

news.content_zh: 2026年10月22日,美国众议院能源和商业委员会代表民主党,要求CDC主任就一项针对新生儿的不道德乙型肝炎研究作出回应。新闻稿强调了该研究的伦理问题,但并未提供具体案例、死亡或暴露的细节。该事件被归类为政治调查,而非确认的健康事件。目前的回应状态为调查中,未明确提及风险等级或影响规模。来源为部分新闻稿,表明无法提取完整的原文内容。这一要求反映了对公共卫生研究实践的持续审查,尤其是涉及新生儿等易感人群的研究。

Meeting Coverage > IDWeek Not Just Moms Who Put Unvaccinated Infants at Risk of Hepatitis B, Study Shows — The findings undermine the CDC's recommendations against universal birth dose vaccination by Terrence Rudd, Staff Writer, MedPage Today October 21, 2026 • 3 min read Add MedPage Today on Google MedpageToday WASHINGTON -- For young children, exposure to hepatitis B virus (HBV) mostly came from someone other than their mother in the household, according to a retrospective cohort study. Among over 158,000 children younger than 5 years, 1.3% lived in a household that had a person with active HBV infection, with 58.2% of those children exposed via contacts who were not their mothers versus 41.8% who were exposed via their mothers, reported Karen Jacobson, MD, MPH, of the Kaiser Permanente Vaccine Study Center in Pleasanton, California, at the IDWeek opens in a new tab or windowannual meeting. "Our findings show that even if it is possible to accurately identify every single maternal infection, this would not account for potential exposure to an infected father, grandparent, or another person living in the household -- and of course anyone that they might come into close contact with outside the household," Jacobson said during a press briefing before the meeting. "Transmission of hepatitis B to children from nonmaternal sources is currently quite rare in the U.S. due to the high vaccination rates," she noted. "But if rates decrease, more infants could be at risk." A universal birth dose of the HBV vaccine protects babiesopens in a new tab or window from such household exposures. Despite that, the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) in December voted to reverse more than three decades of U.S. vaccine policy and stop recommending a universal doseopens in a new tab or window of the HBV vaccine at birth for infants born to mothers who test negative for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg). ACIP continues to recommend that infants born to mothers who test positive or who are unscreened for HBsAg receive a birth dose within 12 hours of delivery. When a mother tests negative, however, ACIP called for shared decision-making about HBV vaccination birth doses. Critics have warned that skipping the universal birth dose will cause preventable acute and chronic HBV infectionsopens in a new tab or window, liver cancers, and deaths, and add millions of dollars in additional healthcare costs. A recent modeling studyopens in a new tab or window suggested that the proposed shared decision-making approach would increase chronic HBV infections by 83%. In babies who don't get a birth dose, ACIP recommended delaying the first dose of the three-dose series to at least age 2 months. But Jacobson's study showed that 4.2% of children exposed to HBV by a nonmaternal household contact were unvaccinated by age 30 days -- within that 2-month window. While 95% of birth-exposed infants were tested for HBV, only 3.6% of children with household exposures were tested. All birth-exposed children were vaccinated within 7 days of birth. Children with household exposure were more likely (93.5%) than those who weren't exposed (86.7%) to be vaccinated. "This suggests that some families or healthcare providers did recognize the potential risk associated with household exposure," Jacobson pointed out. Jacobson and team analyzed laboratory and vaccination data through March for children younger than 5 years who were members of Kaiser Permanente Northern California (KPNC). Children were linked via addresses to birth mothers and households with at least one other KPNC member. The 158,169 children lived in 131,800 households, of which 1,689 had a person with active HBV. Nonmaternal household contacts were older (median age 44) than maternal contacts (median age 38), and 76.5% were male. Because children aren't routinely screened for HBV, Jacobson's team couldn't determine whether any of the household-exposed children developed HBV infections. The study's 1.3% household exposure rate may sound low, Jacobson noted, but "it's important to remember that this is likely an underestimate," and "when infection occurs in infancy, it's highly likely to result in chronic infection with lifelong sequelae." Study limitations included potential inaccurate addresses and underestimates if household contacts with HBV weren't KPNC members. Please enable JavaScript to view the comments powered by Disqus. analysis.time: The study's findings were reported at the IDWeek annual meeting in 2026, with the publication date being October 21, 2026. The data analyzed was through March 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: The study focused on children younger than 5 years in Kaiser Permanente Northern California (KPNC), specifically those living in households with at least one person with active HBV infection.
analysis.event: A retrospective cohort study showed that among children under 5, 1.3% lived in households with active HBV infection, with 58.2% of those children exposed via nonmaternal contacts. The study was presented by Karen Jacobson, MD, MPH, at the IDWeek annual meeting.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Among children exposed to HBV by nonmaternal household contacts, 4.2% were unvaccinated by age 30 days. The study highlighted that household exposure could lead to chronic HBV infections, liver cancers, and deaths, especially if vaccination rates decrease. It also noted that 95% of birth-exposed infants were tested for HBV, while only 3.6% of children with household exposures were tested.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study analyzed laboratory and vaccination data through March 2026. It acknowledged limitations such as potential inaccurate addresses and underestimation of household contacts with HBV who were not KPNC members. The CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) reversed its policy on universal birth dose vaccination, but the study emphasized the importance of considering nonmaternal exposures.

analysis.brief_en: A study presented at the IDWeek annual meeting in 2026 revealed that among children under 5, 1.3% lived in households with active hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, with 58.2% of these children exposed to HBV through nonmaternal contacts. The research, led by Karen Jacobson, MD, MPH, of the Kaiser Permanente Vaccine Study Center, highlighted that even with high vaccination rates, skipping the universal birth dose of HBV vaccine could increase the risk of preventable infections, liver cancers, and deaths. The study found that 4.2% of children exposed to HBV by nonmaternal household contacts were unvaccinated by age 30 days. While 95% of birth-exposed infants were tested for HBV, only 3.6% of children with household exposures were tested. Jacobson emphasized that nonmaternal exposures should not be overlooked, as they can lead to chronic infections with lifelong consequences. The CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) voted to stop recommending a universal birth dose for infants born to mothers who test negative for HBV, instead advocating for shared decision-making. Critics warned that this change could result in a significant rise in HBV infections, with a modeling study suggesting an 83% increase in chronic infections. The study also noted limitations, including potential inaccuracies in address data and underestimation of HBV-positive household contacts not affiliated with KPNC.
